title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: 立春 (Start of Spring )在中国农历中表示春天的开始。立春之后， 白天变得更长，天气也愈发温暖，万物开始复苏，大地充满生机。人们常说"一年之计在于春"，农民在这个时节开始播种，为全年的丰收打下基础。中国人早在三千年前就己开始在立春这一天举行庆祝活动。数百年来，迎春一直是民间的重要习俗。在春暖花开的日子里，人们常常外出游玩，欣赏春天的美景。
reference: Lichun (Start of Spring) marks the beginning of spring in the Chinese lunar calendar. After Lichun, the days grow longer and the weather becomes warmer; everything comes back to life, and the earth is full of vitality. As people often say, "The whole year's work depends on a good start in spring." At this time of year, farmers start sowing to lay the foundation for a good harvest throughout the whole year. In fact, the Chinese have started to hold celebrations on this day as early as 3,000 years ago. For centuries, welcoming spring has been an important folk custom. Today, on warm spring days when flowers are in full bloom, people often go out for outings to enjoy the beautiful scenery of spring.
